title: fix(i18n): make `en` the complete source of truth for grid import and set-password (#2872 b/c)
body:
Addresses parts **(b)** and **(c)** of #2872 — the halves that need no translation-strategy decision. Part (a) (~357 keys × 8 packs) is untouched and still needs your call.

## The drift

`fallbackLng: 'en'` turns a missing key into English rather than an error, and the missing-key handler only fires in dev. So the packs had drifted **in both directions** without anything failing:

**(b) 74 keys existed only in `zh`.** `grid.import.*` and `auth.setPassword.*` were never added to `en`. English rendered fine — from call-site `defaultValue:` args and a private map inside `ImportWizard` — which is exactly why nobody noticed. But `en` is what translators and `os i18n extract` read as the source, so those strings were **untranslatable in the other eight languages**.

**(c) 4 `en` keys were missing from `zh`** — `console.commandPalette.title`, two `console.ai.suggestions.metadataAssistant.*`, and `help.keyboardShortcuts` — so Chinese users got English.

`grid.import` turned out worse than the issue recorded: **three** disagreeing sources, with no two the same set.

| source | keys |
|---|---|
| `en.grid.import` | 62 |
| `zh.grid.import` | 130 |
| `IMPORT_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` | 133 |
| union | **134** |

All three now agree on 134, and `en` ↔ `zh` are at exact parity: **2448 keys each, zero gaps in either direction**.

## One deliberate departure from the issue

The issue said to "消除 `ImportWizard` 的私有 `DEFAULTS` 兜底". I did **not** delete it. Reading the code, it is not accidental redundancy — it is what lets the wizard render when no `I18nProvider` is mounted (standalone embedding, unit tests), and `useImportTranslation` handles both the hook-throws and probe-misses cases against it. Deleting it would break that path.

Pinning it to the `en` pack with a test is what actually prevents recurrence, and it keeps the fallback working. Same reasoning as objectstack#3679: when two sources must coexist, pin them rather than pick one.

I also didn't derive the map from `en` at runtime — importing the full 2448-key pack into `plugin-grid` purely for a fallback would show up in the bundle budget.

## Also

`SetPasswordPage` drops its now-redundant inline `defaultValue:` args. Rendered text is byte-identical (I matched the pack strings to the existing defaults character-for-character, including "if SSO **ever becomes** unavailable"); it just resolves from the pack now.

## Testing

Two new guards, **both mutation-verified**:
- `en-zh-key-parity.test.ts` — asserts both directions, plus a floor on the flattened key count so the walker can't pass vacuously. Dropping one `zh` key fails it.
- `ImportWizard.i18n-parity.test.ts` — same key set *and* same text as `en.grid.import`. Drifting one string fails it.

The other eight packs are deliberately **not** asserted: they are ~357 keys behind `en`, so a full ten-pack parity test would fail on arrival. That is #2872 part (a) and needs the translation-strategy decision first.

Suites: `@object-ui/i18n` + `@object-ui/plugin-grid` 368 passed (48 files), `turbo type-check` 35/35, ESLint 0 errors and no new warnings.
